cells.gaps: The 2009 sector policy's five-year period ended in 2014 without the review being carried out, and no evidence row shows a sector policy in preparation to succeed it; the end year is reckoned from the adoption, the source giving none. Nothing is held on its text, delivery plan, reporting, governance or the last twelve months.
cells.note: Document de politique sectorielle 2009: adopted in July 2009 and expired in 2014 with no sector-policy successor on record, so it sets no rung. A national digital strategy is held, which is noted and does not place the country.
